notes.title: Balance Patch 0.5.1
notes.notes:
Patch 0.5.1

Yes, the patches now have numbers to tell them apart.

Some changes in the last patch were a bit much, bringing the meta to be pretty range-focused.
This patch will come with some buffs to bring back fruits and roots again.

Balance:

🟢Agility: Teleport distance: 500 --> 700 | Ranged units no longer teleport to backline. | Agility buff: +3 new fields --> +4 new fields
🟢Banana: 12HP --> 13HP
🟡Apple: 6HP --> 5HP | 3DMG --> 4DMG
🔴Cabbage: +5HP per adjacent leafy --> +4HP per adjacent leafy
🟢Leek: 12HP --> 14HP
🟢Liquorice: 12HP --> 13HP
🟡Redcap: 5HP --> 3HP | 1DMG --> 2DMG
🟢Cauliflower: 6HP --> 4HP | Gives +3HP --> Gives +4HP
🟢Avocado: 5DMG --> 6DMG


Fixes:

Fixed a bug where barley with revive would turn into broccoli.
Got reports that the balance totem was still bugged. Tried a new fix.
Retried to fix a crash issue that only a very small handful of players experienced.


//Bocary

notes.title: SEASON 3 UPDATE
notes.notes:
-- SEASON 3 BEGINS --
Your rank has been reset, and player icons have been awarded depending on your rank.

4 new crops join:

Wheat (Grain)
Barley (Grain)
Quinoa (Grain)
Venus Flytrap (Leafy)


New post-combat reward:

 Scarecrow. Gives +4 new fields and a 0 DMG 8HP Scarecrow that can be placed on the field.


The new grain build synergizes with having scarecrows.

Battlecry keyword added. This keyword triggers at the start of combat. It doesn't trigger on revive.

Balance changes & Updates:

🟡Redcap: Ability renamed to: "Battlecry: Spawn 2 clones"
🟡Garlic: Ability renamed to: "Battlecry: Gain Immunity (3s)"
🟡Corn Rework: 3 DMG --> 1 DMG | 11HP --> 8HP | Ability changed to: "Battlecry: Spawn a Scarecrow"
🟡Rice Rework: 1 field occupation --> 2 field occupation. | 1 DMG --> 2 DMG | 6HP --> 9HP | Ability changed to: "When picked: Also gain a Scarecrow"
🟡Cauliflower Rework: 4HP --> 6HP | Ability changed to: "Gives +3HP". //Dev comment: As rice had to be reworked to fit with the grain archetype, I wanted another crop to take over its old ability (it's neat to have in the game). Cauliflower seemed to suit the most.
🟢Charge field buff: +4 new fields --> +5 new fields.
🔴Carrot: 13HP --> 9HP
🔴Mangosteen: 0.22 Attackspeed --> 0.20 Attackspeed
🔴Apple: 4 DMG --> 3 DMG
🔴Banana: 15 HP --> 12 HP
🔴Chili: Ability changed to: "+1 DMG if touching 2 other Spice".
🔴Agility: No longer allows you to place your unit anywhere. Now makes the crop teleport to backline after 1 second. (Like the assassin rat from PvE).
🟡Slow mechanic reworked: No longer freezes when slowing for a second time. Instead, each slow will apply a stacking reduction to attackspeed (-0.05 attack speed per slow stack, capped at 0.10 attackspeed). Slow is now always permanent. //Dev comment: The freeze mechanic was fun to experiment with. It might come back as a crop-specific ability in the future, but for now, the grapes permafreeze was not fun to play against.


Other:

Added artist credits to all crops in the collection screen.
Adjusted the price to buy some crops (generally a little bit cheaper).
Made it possible to see crops abilities before you buy them, instead of keeping them secret.
Restructured the player icon screen with some new navigation buttons.
Every 3rd tick of drought will now increase drought damage by 1. This is to avoid Venus Flytraps with tons of damage making infinite rounds.

Rating system has been changed a bit for season 3: The requirements for ranks has increased:
Bronze: <1000 rating
Silver: 1000-1199 rating
Gold: 1200-1399 rating
Emerald: 1400-1599 rating
Diamond: 1600-1799 rating
Master: 1800-1999 rating
Grandmaster: 2000+ rating

Fixes:

Fixed a bug where the fiery ghost pepper player icon would not show properly in games.
Fixed a bug where lemon projectiles could be seen flying off-screen after the battle.
Hopefully fixed a bug where balance totem would not give unlimited range as expected.
Avocado infobox now correctly says "+2 DMG per unique adjacent root"
Hopefully fixed a rare bug that made the game crash for a few people on launch (caused by some corrupted file in the cache).

 
Expect balance changes and fixes in the coming days.

As usual, the PvP environment might still have old/unchanged crops from the old season. Give it a few hours to settle :)

//Bocary

notes.title: Root Update
notes.notes:
Hi Cropsters!

In my endeavour to make more refined and better synergies in the game, fruits and roots are getting some love and changes!

Balance and changes:

🔴Armor is no longer a "counter" that is stackable. Armor is now simply a buff that makes a crop take -1 damage. Walnut now says "Has Armor" and flow totem says "Gives Armor". //Dev comment: This is essentially a "revert" of the armor stacking made possible in the last update, since it was too strong to have 2 armor on anything.
🟡Carrot: Ability changed to: "+3 HP per adjacent ROOT"
🟢Avocado: Ability changed to: "Knockback. +2 DMG per adjacent ROOT"
🟡Eggplant: Ability changed to: "+300 range per other adjacent ROOT"
🟡Apple: Ability changed to: "+1 DMG per unique adjacent FRUIT"
🟢/🟡Cabbage: Ability changed to: "+5 HP per other adjacent LEAFY"
🔴Ice Rat (PvE): 0.43 attack speed --> 0.39 attack speed
🟡Lemon: Now correctly says "+1 DMG if touching OTHER citrus"
🟡Cayenne: Now correctly says "+1 DMG if touching OTHER spice"
🔴Pumpkin: Now says "+1 DMG / +4 HP per unique adjacent type". //Dev comment: This is a slight nerf to pumpkin, but the point is to make the pumpkin build a rainbow-type build where you want 1 crop from each type. Maybe there will be another crop to support this archetype later!
🔴Portobello: Sporeguards 0.52 attackspeed --> 0.48 attackspeed


Other:

Added a new player icon achieved by subscribing to Bocary's YouTube channel! (Hover it in the collection and click subscribe)


Fixes:

Fixed a bug where balance totem would bug and make ranged crops have 0 range.
Fixed a bug where clicking the "Waiting..." text in duos would turn it into a big unpressable Confirm button.



As always, remember that the PvP environment takes a few hours to settle in with the new changes, so you might still see old/unnerfed crops in ranked.


If you want to follow the current CROPS! tournament, check out the latest video here:
https://youtu.be/jeq7-DBkqsk?si=aFKwpQucBQmlYv_q

//Bocary

notes.title: Balance patch
notes.notes:
Greetings Cropsters!

A new patch just landed.

Balance:

🟢Dragonfruit: 530 Range --> 600 Range
🔴Starfruit: 9HP --> 7HP
🔴Apple: 2.5 movespeed --> 1.8 movespeed
🟡Garlic rework: 1.8 movespeed --> 2.0 movespeed | 20HP --> 17HP | Ability changed to: "Has immunity (3s)" | Shape changed to reverse starfruit shape. //Dev comment: Even though the drought ability was very innovative and cool in theory, it just wasn't healthy for the meta. Many people disliked it, and having an ability that basically counters every ranged combo is just too strong. We have cherry/agility/immunity that does that, but more balanced. Now it's just a pretty decent tank unit that synergizes with starfruit, as their shapes fit perfectly (the immunity also gives starfruit some time to charge!)
🟢Orange: 8HP --> 9HP | 400 range --> 450 range | 0.40 attackspeed --> 0.43 attackspeed //Dev comment: The slow removal from orange made it severely underperform. It is now getting some compensation in stats.
🟡/🟢Speed Totem rework: Now gives crop to the left unlimited range and crop to the right charge. Name changed to: Balance Totem. //Dev comment: The speed totem has just always been inferior compared to all other totems. This makes it a viable option, as many builds rely on unlimited range.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068446/cdd6996bfa5a2b8bf838ff7689fefd506bbc6c69.png

Other changes:

Added the option to switch between type-view and compact-view in the loadout screen.
Christmas drops has been made a bit more likely to obtain. Legendary --> Epic | Epic --> Rare
The loadout can now only be edited from the play menu, and not in the collection tab. It was simply too much work to have it there, so i'd rather remove it for now and focus my time on new features.


Fixes:


Fixed a bug where non-English languages would cause errors.
Duos player database now properly expanded by 50%. (wasn't applied in duos by mistake)
Knockback buff has been removed as it was causing issues over and over. It will be replaced with a new reward that I've been cooking on.


*Keep in mind that old/unchanged crops might still linger in the PvP environment until new builds are uploaded. It will settle in some hours.

//Bocary

notes.title: CROPSMAS UPDATE
notes.notes:
Cropsmas update!

December is upon us!

New seasonal theme with music and snow-effect added to the game (can be turned off in menu).

Christmas drops are here!
Epic drop chance (12% / 8+ wins):

Christmas Cabbage player icon
Snowman player icon

Reindeer Cherry skin
Elfplant skin

Legendary drop chance (8% / 10 wins):

Snowflake player icon
Snowball Grapes skin
Christmas Tree Pineapple skin

New feature: Crop types
Crop types added!
Each crop now has a type. Some crops now interact with certain crop types.
Currently working on adding bonuses when having multiple of the same type. This is not yet done though.
Check out the crop types:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068446/5dbdd444dec3bc29113058a13d342bc7e5e8326d.jpg

Full list of new crop types:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068446/8242d9d113bf16cf419f9237f0ca74ee815aa824.png

New crops added!

Blueberry
Dragonfruit

New mechanic: Freeze.
When slowing a target who is already slowed, the target will be frozen for 3s (it can't do anything while frozen).

Balancing and changes:
🟡 Mushroom: Name changed to Redcap. //Dev comment: Same reasoning as Chili rename to Cayenne. I don't want crops to have "general" names now that there are crop types in the game. This should be the last rename of older crops though. 
🟢Cabbage: Ability changed to "+4HP per adjacent Root".
🟢Corn: Ability changed to "+2DMG per 3 adjacent Grain".
🟢Eggplant: Ability changed to "unlimited range if touching Nut".
🟢Carrot: Ability changed to "+3HP per adjacent Leafy".
🟢Lemon: Ability changed to: "+1 DMG if touching Exotic"
🟡 Grapes: 0.52 attackspeed --> 0.33 attackspeed | 2 DMG --> 3 DMG //Dev comment: the new freeze mechanic is an interesting addition to grapes. To balance it out, it now has lower attack speed and 1 extra dps.

🟢Pumpkin: 11HP --> 12HP.

Other:

The number of crops you can buy in the demo of the game increased to 5 from 4.

* Chantarelle
* Ghost Pepper
* Wheat

Well met, cropsters.

notes.title: Music patch
notes.notes:
Music patch!

Added 5 new soundtracks - one for each island.

The new soundtracks are more atmospheric than the last one - and a unique track for each island makes the game feel less repetitive!

The soundtracks will now smoothly transition between battle music and plant-phase music.

All sounds/music in the game has been turned into stereo rather than mono, creating a more emersive experience.

Other:

If a crop has 50% or more crit chance, it will now display a red crit icon rather than the regular.
If you are in a duos lobby, you will stay in the lobby between each game.

Fixes:

Fixed a bug where you could see info about Grapes before purchasing it.
Fixed a bug where chamomile infobox did not show up.

//Bocary

* Selecting an island will now also choose that island properly when playing duos.

* Assassin rat now has 33% chance to spawn instead of 50% in adventure mode (grass island).

* The PvP database has been increased by 50%, storing more builds for PvP and giving more variety.

* Small fixes in the code.

notes.title: Balance and changes
notes.notes:
Balance and changes
🍋 🍎 🥦 🥕 🍌 🍅 🥬 🥑 🍒 🍍

Game Changes:

Draught now triggers after 30s (up from 20s). //Dev comment: draught was never meant to "determine" fights, but to prevent endless ones from occurring. This change will make draught-triggers considerably more rare.
A deck of crops has been changed to 9 (down from 10). This makes it easier to build around combos and synergies.
Grapes has been removed from the starting pool of crops, and added back as an unlockable crop in the shop. Anyone who played CROPS! prior to this patch will still have grapes unlocked.
The color of Aloe Vera healing zone is now teal for enemy and green for allied.


Balance changes:
🟢: Buff
🔴: Nerf

🟢 Garlic --> 20 HP (up from 18). Reduces draught timer by 12s (up from 8).
🟢 Lime --> 0.40 attacks/sec (up from 0.39)
🔴 Pumpkin --> +4 HP per unique adjacent (down from +5)
🔴 Chamomile --> 10s per spawn (up from 9s)
🔴 Saplings --> Attack speed reduced slightly to 0.42 (down from 0.44)
🟢 Avocado --> 7HP (up from 6)
🟢 Eggplant --> Effect changed to: Unlimited range if touching Walnut. //Dev comment: showing some love to the older crops is gonna be great for the meta. Also a Walnut frontline with artillery eggplants is just awesome.
🔴 Orange --> Attackspeed reduced to 0.40 attacks/sec (down from 0.43). Movespeed reduced to 1.6 (down from 2.1)
🟢 Cabbage --> 24 HP (up from 23)
🔴 Corn --> 11HP (down from 12HP) //Dev comment: as the loadout size changed from 10 to 9, the strong corn-spam strategy has become a bit easier to get. This nerf compensates for that while still keeping the build viable.


Fixes:

The lime icon hitbox was too small.
Enemy pineapple can no longer target an enemy bamboo.


As usual, the PvP environment might still have unnerfed/unbuffed crops for the next few hours.

Join the discord! https://discord.gg/XkVtfNy6M2


Also, if you havn't left a review for CROPS! yet, feel free to do so. It helps out more than you can imagine!
Thank you ❤️

//Bocary

notes.title: Balance changes

Greetings Cropsters,

This patch brings in balance changes to half of the crops in the game.

New crops will be joining the frey in 2-3 weeks.

Here are the full patch notes:

Small additions:

"Deselect all crops"-button has been added to the loadout screen.
The loadout button has been added to the collection screen for convenience.


Balance changes:

Jalapeño: reduced HP: 6 --> 5, reduced ranged 370 --> 310
Springonion: Stun duration reduced 2.5s --> 1.7s. Dev comment: The spring onion is intended more as a "supporty" crop that buffs other crops like apple and carrot. The stunlock made it a top-tier standalone crop (and unbeatable round 1 crop in PvP), which has now been addressed.

Strawberry HP Reduced: 17 --> 16
Lemon: Increased range: 430 --> 470
Potato: Increased HP: 12 --> 13
Pumpkin: HP Increased 8 --> 12. Dev comment: the pumpkin was underperforming compared to its massive field occupation. A bump up in base HP will give it more power. I am also brewing on new field buff ideas, for example: one that will give immunity to stun/knockback in combat (which is pumpkin's biggest weakness by far)


Bugfixes:

Fixed 2 different (both hard to find) bugs that allowed players to stack crops on fields.


Join the discord if you havn't <3
https://discord.gg/XkVtfNy6M2

All the best

notes.title: Big update !
notes.notes:
Greetings Cropsters !

A pretty big update hitting this time. The new main additions are:

4 new crops: Starfruit (fan-crop by Ryan "Chill" Foy!), Cauliflower, Avocado and Pumpkin.

As more and more crops are joining the frey, a new feature has been implemented to secure you can always play with your favourite crops. Let me present:
Loadouts: You now pick 10 crops to play with in a game of CROPS.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068446/a5ab4be4562bf51be31c261679784a8fe268caee.png

Extended stats: You can now toggle "Extended stats" by clicking on the magnifying glass in a game of CROPS. You can always right-click a crop infobox to see the extended stats, even though it has not been toggled on.

These extended stats will be further expanded in the future. For now, it allows you to see the crop range (in pixels), attack speed (in attacks/second) and move speed (in pixels/frame)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068446/829b1847f1248542e888d580fc2a729bc6a7195b.png


New buff: +1 permanent reroll. Adds 5 new fields!

Here is a list of the full patch notes:

Balance changes:
Cabbage: 23HP down from 25HP, but gains +4 per adjacent lemon/carrot up from +2.

Carrot --> +3HP per adjacent springonion up from +2.

Cherry --> 18HP down from 20HP.

Corn --> 12HP down from 13HP.

Broccoli --> 7HP down from 8HP. Slightly lowered movespeed.

Springonion --> Now properly stunlocks a target in a 1v1. (Was inconsistent before)

Jalapeño --> Slightly lower attack speed.

Summoner (lava island) --> Slightly lower attack speed.

Boar (grass island miniboss) --> +5HP

Lizard Javelin (mountain island) --> A bit faster attack speed.


Other
Apple and Grapes are now unlocked by default along with the 8 original starting crops, as 10 crops is needed to play.

You can now see your number of rerolls left.

You can no longer press the PvP button if you don't have an internet connection.

Bugfixes
Fixed a bug where you could plant multiple crops on each other.

Fixed a bug where the artillery achievement could be earned with some of the newer melee crops.

Fixed a bug where people could possibly get banned for no apparent reason. If this extremely rare case happened to you, you can always reach out to me on Discord: Bocary.

Fixed a bug where the "Kaboom" achievement would be given to you if you faced a Tomato with 5+ bonus damage in PvP.

The game no longer soft-locks when only cabbages are left in a PvP match. "Sudden death" will trigger, dealing 1 damage to them every 0.5s

You can now de-select "Random Island" by clicking it again.

Added a visual effect when placing totems.

Some crop prices have been increased.


Shoutout to Shy#2528 for getting 1st on the Leaderboard on all islands! (PvE mode)

Shoutout to Ryan "Chill" Foy for designing the Starfruit crop!


Also join the discord if you havn't yet:  https://discord.gg/XkVtfNy6M2


Further balancing and fixes to newly introduced bugs will come in a patch soon.

//Bocary

notes.title: 120 FPS update!
notes.notes:
Greetings Cropsters!

As my mission for more QoL continues, I have made some nice improvements!


 You can now switch between 60/90/120 FPS in the settings menu. And what's even nicer: the game detects your monitor frequency and sets the FPS automatically so you don't even have to worry about it :)
 You can now click to instantly skip Victory/Defeat screen.
 Score calculation: Crops surviving in combat now gives +3 score per crop, instead of +1.
 Changed the font in the collection tabs for better readability.
